title: Clay after School
story: Mina stayed after school for the clay club on Wednesdays. She wanted to make a cup for her father. The first cup leaned to one side and she had to start again. The leader, Paul, showed her how to keep her hands wet and steady. Mina pressed the walls until they were even. She scratched her name under the base. Paul said the cup would dry on a shelf until Friday. Then they would bake it in the kiln. Mina washed the grey clay off her fingers and smiled. A crooked cup had taught her to slow down. She could not wait to see the finished colour.
